title: Five checks for a hospital's equipment program

blocks.text: A hospital plans its equipment replacements over a few years. Each item is installed in one year, pays its whole `cost` ($k) in that year and needs `engineer_days` of the biomedical engineers' time in that year. It may be installed in any plan year from its `release` year to its `deadline` year. Items marked `required` must be installed. An item may name another it `excludes` (the two need the same room, so at most one is installed). The finance office gives a `budget` per year and the engineering office `engineers` (days available) per year, both keyed by the plan's years. Each department has a `dept_minimum`: the least the plan must spend on that department in total.
Before the hospital's model is ever solved, the planners want the input checked for five known causes of "no plan":

rows: a required item has no plan year in its window
a required item costs more than the budget in every year it may use
a required item needs more engineer-days than are available in every year it may use
both items' names, sorted, joined by `"|"`
two required items exclude each other
a department's minimum is more than all its items together cost

blocks.text: The plan years are the keys of `budget`; `engineers` has the same keys. For the `"minimum"` check, "all its items together" means every item of the department, required or optional, whatever its window. (Leaving out an item whose window misses every plan year is sound too, and the tests accept either.)

Write `precheck(items, budget, engineers, dept_minimum)` returning the sorted list of `(check, subject)` pairs, each pair once. Every check must be **sound**: it may fire only when no plan can exist, so a program with a plan always gets `[]`. Work out, for each check, which quantity has to be the least possible demand and which the most possible supply. About twenty-five lines.

cases.says: clean data passes, and each of the five planted causes is named once
a window can be in order and still miss every plan year
an item that fits in some year of its window is not a problem
an exclusion between items is a problem only when the plan must fund both
a department's minimum can be met with optional items as well as required ones

origin.section: A Check Must Never Refuse a Scenario That Has a Plan

concepts: five input checks, each comparing a least demand with a most supply
